---
title: "Output Check"
df-print: paged
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
if (!exists("aoi")) source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: output-check
#| results: asis

slide_list <- read_csv(here("source", "slide-list.csv"), col_types = "cccddcc")

plots_dir <- here("03-render-output", "plots")
maps_dir <- here("03-render-output", "maps")

existing_plots <- list.files(plots_dir)
existing_maps <- list.files(maps_dir)

# Split by type
all_maps <- slide_list %>% filter(type == "map", conditions != "none")
all_plots <- slide_list %>% filter(type == "plot", conditions != "none")

created_maps <- all_maps %>% filter(filename %in% existing_maps)
missing_maps <- all_maps %>% filter(filename %ni% existing_maps)

created_plots <- all_plots %>% filter(filename %in% existing_plots)
missing_plots <- all_plots %>% filter(filename %ni% existing_plots)

# --- Created Maps ---
print_text(paste_bold(paste0("Created Maps: ", nrow(created_maps), "/", nrow(all_maps))))
if (nrow(created_maps) > 0) {
  created_maps %>% select(slide, filename) %>% print_paged_df()
}

# --- Missing Maps ---
print_text(paste_bold(paste0("Missing Maps: ", nrow(missing_maps), "/", nrow(all_maps))))
if (nrow(missing_maps) > 0) {
  missing_maps %>% select(slide, filename, warning_text) %>% print_paged_df()
}

# --- Created Plots ---
print_text(paste_bold(paste0("Created Plots: ", nrow(created_plots), "/", nrow(all_plots))))
if (nrow(created_plots) > 0) {
  created_plots %>% select(slide, filename) %>% print_paged_df()
}

# --- Missing Plots ---
print_text(paste_bold(paste0("Missing Plots: ", nrow(missing_plots), "/", nrow(all_plots))))
if (nrow(missing_plots) > 0) {
  missing_plots %>% select(slide, filename, warning_text) %>% print_paged_df()
}

# --- Summary ---
print_text(paste0(
  paste_bold("Summary: "),
  nrow(created_maps), " maps + ", nrow(created_plots), " plots created, ",
  nrow(missing_maps), " maps + ", nrow(missing_plots), " plots missing"
))
```
